text: Hi Tiago, it's Denise from purchasing. I'll be quick. We need the bracket two millimetres thinner on the next order. Same length, same holes, just thinner. I know we approved the current spec back in May, so yes, this is a change, and yes, it is short notice. Can you tell me by Thursday if that works? If it doesn't work, tell me what does, because I do need something different from what we have now. Call me, please. Don't send an email, I will not read it today.
Before I confirm, can I check one thing?
Can I ask what's driving this?
Do you mean lighter, or physically smaller?
Just to be clear, the length stays the same?
So what you need is a lighter box, not a thinner part.
